numeric_state_parity.sample_scope: 240 warmup ticks + 1200 maneuver ticks, observer off; fingerprint covers numeric simulation state and effective inputs at selected boundaries only, not all session/event state; no wall-clock timing claim.

limitations: Only two original and two candidate native samples per aircraft; no three-run performance qualification.
Candidate capture 02-55AX had 2548 frames, 13,536 simulation ticks and 292 measured frame intervals >=30 ms; it is retained, not filtered.
Candidate 03-55AX produced 3510 frames and 14,404 ticks, showing high within-candidate variability.
Frame diagnostics and resource sampling add overhead; observer identity/hash is retained.
Render GPU values may be delayed and are not directly additive to frame time.
Process CPU/RSS are direct process counters; engine rendering memory estimates are not VRAM.
Candidate comparisons use direct flight bootstrap, not AppRoot/Home UI route.
Concurrent user app/resource pressure made reversals unusable; no causal attribution to code changes is supported.
The final frozen D app was restored to candidate source hashes; the live C app was never modified by this campaign.

diagnostic_findings.scope: Offline correlation of frame intervals with sampled process/physics CPU, render CPU/GPU, collector poll and setup arrays. Raw-array quantiles use nearest-rank; frame percentiles are taken from each native report.

candidate_55ax.interpretation: Candidate run 02 is a captured outlier across process CPU, physics CPU, render CPU and positive GPU timing versus candidate run 03. It had 292 frame intervals >=30 ms, of which 192 were >=50 ms. Setup and observer-poll p95 were below 0.2 ms and 0.04 ms. These sampled scopes are not additive to wall frame time, GPU timestamps may be delayed, and this does not identify a root cause. Candidate 03 returned near the original 55AX timing range.

reversal_environment.interpretation: Both original-source reversals are excluded from causal comparison. The P51 ended out of focus and paused. The 55AX coincided with zero measured free space on C: and a 7.39 GiB low watermark for system-available memory; the parent observed external C-app Godot processes during the reversal window.
